en: An old sepia-toned waterside scene showing a small ornamental pavilion or birdhouse on a pond with a large white bird (likely a swan or goose) standing on a ramp. Behind the water is a low stone embankment and terrace covered with creeping plants, with stairs leading down to the water. Above the terrace stands a long, single‑storey building with a tiled roof and wooden veranda, next to older multi‑storey houses with steep gabled roofs and chimneys. The upper part of the image is stained and partially faded, consistent with an aged photographic postcard. No visible printed caption or handwriting appears on the front.
